conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Neil from Amazon Account Security. I'm calling regarding a recent notification you should have received about irregular activity on your new Amazon account. I want to assure you we're here to keep your account safe.
Hi, yes, I did get an email but I wasn't sure if it was real. I just signed up last week.

Absolutely, and I understand your concern. It's our policy to reach out directly to confirm the legitimacy of any alerts. Your security is our top priority. May I confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon profile for verification?
Uh, yeah, it should be Emily Carson.
Thank you, Emily. For your protection, could you also verify the email address linked to your account?
Sure, it's emily.carson123@gmail.com.
Perfect, thank you. The alert was triggered by a login attempt from an unrecognized device in Texas. Have you ever accessed your account from there?
No, I'm in Ohio. I only used my laptop at home.

That's exactly why we're concerned. To ensure your account hasn't been compromised, I need to perform a remote diagnostic. This is a standard Amazon protocol for new customers experiencing suspicious activity.
Um, what does that mean?

It simply means we'll have you open a secure Amazon support portal so I can guide you through verifying your account integrity. Could you please open your browser and go to www.amazon-support-secure.com?
Okay, I'm typing that in now.
Great. You should see a page titled 'Amazon Security Verification'. Please click the blue button labeled 'Begin Verification'.
Alright, I see it. I clicked it.
Excellent. Now, the page is asking for your account phone number and a verification code. Please enter your phone number, and I will read the code to you in a moment.
It's 555-129-4837. Ready for the code.
Thank you. The code is 904317. Enter that and press 'Continue'.
Done.

Thanks for cooperating, Emily. I just want to say, I'm under a lot of pressure to ensure accounts like yours are protected, and if this isn't resolved properly, I could lose my position. So I hope you'll help me finish this process.
I'll do my best, I just don't want my account to get locked.

That's exactly what we're trying to prevent. Now, it appears there was an unauthorized order for a $600 Amazon gift card using your account. To fully secure your profile, Amazon requires a temporary validation payment using the same method as the suspicious purchase.
Wait, I don't want to buy a gift card. Why do I need to do that?

I understand it sounds unusual, but this is a standard fraud prevention step. By completing a validation purchase matching the flagged transaction, it allows us to confirm the true account holder. The amount will be fully refunded to your payment method once the review is complete.
Are you sure this is safe? I'm not familiar with how this works.

Absolutely, Emily. I want to reassure you: you're dealing directly with Amazon Security, and all funds will be returned. If you don't complete this step, your account may be frozen for up to 90 days, which I'd hate to see happen.
Okay, what do I need to do?

Please purchase a $600 Amazon gift card from our authorized list. You can use your bank card or a payment app, whichever is easier. Once you have the card, read me the claim code and we'll validate your account instantly.
So just buy an Amazon gift card and give you the code?

That's correct. If you'd like, I can stay on the line while you complete the purchase, or if you prefer, I can call you back in 10 minutes. Please know, if this isn't resolved today, your account could be marked for permanent suspension and a fraud investigation.
I guess I'll just get it now. Should I do it online or in a store?
Either method works. If you use Amazon's online store, you'll immediately receive the code. I recommend the fastest option, so we can secure your profile before any further unauthorized access.
Alright, I'll do it online right now.
Thank you, Emily. As a reminder, once you have the code, please read it carefully to me so I can input it into our security system. This ensures your refund is processed and your account cleared.
